items.text: Hi LEGO Party players! This is a patch full of fixes that we have seen pop up or have been reported to us. Thanks again for your continued support, please read on below for full patch notes, and share your feedback with us here and in the forums!
-Fictions & SMG Studio
Improved flow for applying custom game rules
Fixed Ping not displaying correctly in Public Games
Resolved occasional crash when exiting a Challenge Zone to the Main Menu
Fixed Occasional Crash when activating the Volcano in the Pirate Challenge Zone
Fixed Disconnect that could occur when playing the Dance Off Minigame
Fixed the Bionicle Cosplayer Minfigure having the incorrect color on its shoulder pads
Added additional carrot earning rewards for max level players - each Challenge Zone played will reward 100 carrots per round upon completion.
Fixed Rejoin button triggering when not displayed in the Main Menu
Fixed the number of save Icons not updating when deleting a saved game.

To all those who have played LEGO Party, shared it with friends of family, engaged with the community, and continued giving feedback since launch last September, thank you!

We've gotten tons of requests for new features and content since the game's release, but the most common request by far has been public multiplayer. The team at SMG has been hard at work adding to the game over the past 10 months and, earlier this year, they started building a cross-platform public lobby system. It's available now!

This is LEGO Party's biggest update yet, but it won't be the last one. We'll share more on future updates when we can, but until then, have fun, read on below for full patch notes, and share your feedback with us here and in the forums!
-Fictions & SMG Studio
Public Lobbies! You can now host or join public games. Play your favorite Challenge Zone or Minigame Rush playlist with other partygoers from across the globe all platforms!
New Challenge Zone game modes! Switch up your next party with one of 4 new game modes to play across Challenge Zones.
Advanced Game Rules! Mix up your next Challenge Zone with customised rules, such as Multi-Brick Purchase!

For those of you playing on multiple platforms or just getting your news here, this update also gets LEGO® Party optimised for Nintendo Switch 2! Higher frame rate, sharper visuals, and a free upgrade for owners of the Nintendo Switch version!
New Series 29 Minifigures to play and customise!
Various bug fixes and performance improvements.
And for those of you who want to know about absolutely everything:
Public Lobbies
Create and join public game lobbies of LEGO® Party!
Choose from a list of public Challenge Zone & Minigame Rush lobbies, hosted by other players around the world.
Invite your friends or play against random players worldwide as you compete for the most Golden Bricks!
Challenge Zone Game Modes (The Lab)
4 new exciting modes to mix up your Challenge Zone play!
Crazy Feet: board spaces change randomly with every pass over!
Raining Bricks: Golden Bricks falling from the sky every 2 rounds. Who can collect the most and win the game?
Stinky Feet: each time a board space is passed over, the space is degraded until nothing but danger remains!
Hidden Brick: several Treasure Chests drop around the map, but only one contains a lucrative Golden Brick! Find it first and reshuffle the chests!
These modes unlock with progression, with all modes being unlocked at level 10.
Challenge Zone Game Rules
Tweak your Challenge Zone experience with new game rules in LEGO® Party!
Brick Head Starts have been moved into this section.
Brick Cost Modifiers: change the starting cost and whether the price escalates or changes!
Brick Vendor Modifiers: Tired of him moving around? He can now be made stationary! Want to buy multiple bricks a visit? That can be turned on too!
This update adds support for a native Nintendo Switch 2 version of the game, offering higher frame rates and sharper visuals.
A free upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is available for all owners of LEGO® Party! on Nintendo Switch.
Space: UFO Drilling Animation now faces the correct way.
Updated Cutscene for when nothing is stolen on a Chance Space.
Minifigures now react when stealing from themselves on a Chance Space, and no longer turn invisible.
Space: Alien mind control VFX no longer remains under the UFO in the garage animation.
Pirate: Studs now follow the raft movement correctly.
Disconnecting and reconnecting whilst viewing the map will no longer soft lock the game.
Viewing the map whilst using Reverso now shows the correct number of spaces.
Game Show Fixes
Bumble-Bee drummer no longer wields both sausages and drumsticks whilst drumming.
Minigame Fixes
Studs added to the glove in results screen.
Bonus Bricks Fixes
Most Slapped now tracks and awards correctly.
Fixed soft lock at end of the Bonus Bricks sequence.
Being left behind in Fall Wheel Drive now counts as an elimination.
General Fixes
LEGO® Party ID Usernames are now randomly generated.
Improved error messaging around blocked players.

Hello LEGO Party players! Thank you SO much for your continued enthusiasm and support. We're grateful to everyone who has played the game and shared it with friends and family since launch, almost six months ago.
Today, we're launching another major update to the game that adds one of the most-requested features since launch: BONUS BRICKS!

There's plenty more in the 1.4 update for you all to check out and we hope you'll enjoy the team's unique take on this feature. Read on for full patch notes and look forward to more updates in the coming months.
-SMG Studio & Fictions

Bonus Bricks! Players may choose to add Bonus Bricks to the end of Challenge Zones! Get whisked away to the Bonus Brick Zone and vote on who gets some additional lucrative Golden Bricks at the end of a Challenge Zone!
New exciting 2v2 versions of Minigames added to Brick Battles & Minigame Rush! Team up in new versions of Graffeeti, Slide Hustle, Feeling Golfy & Saucerlord.
Bust a move and create more chaos with new dance moves and interactable objects added to the Minigame Results
15+ New Minifigures available in the Wardrobe, such as the full suite of Classic Spacemen colours and the Alien Commander.
A new language appears! Brazilian Portuguese is now available as a text option in LEGO® Party!
Various bug fixes and performance improvements.
And for those of you who want to know about absolutely everything:
Bonus Bricks
Players can now opt to add Bonus Bricks to the end of their CZ games - from 1-10 bricks
Players can vote from a list of random qualifiers, with the winner being awarded the bonus Golden Brick
New 2v2 Minigames
Graffeeti 2v2
Slide Hustle 2v2
Feeling Golfy 2v2
Saucerlord 2v2
Added Variety to Minigame Results Screen
More dance moves added, selected at random
More items to play with in the scene, from additional banana peels to bowling pins
New Minifigures added
15+ new Minifigures to equip and customise in the Wardrobe
All classic Spacemen colours now available
Brazilian Portuguese added as a supported language for text
New language can be changed in the settings menu
Minigame Changes/Fixes
CPU will no longer score points if they pot the ball in Feeling Golfy after the timer runs out
Tweaks to the power ups in Grafeeti
Fixed quality on the barrels in Animal Census
Fixed lighting on Propeller in Dizzy Driftin
Fixed lighting on platforms on new Donuts & Dragons levels
Multiple fixes to incorrect VO being played
UI/UX & Menu Fixes
Fixed Custom Minigame Rush playlists launching the incorrect game
Added News Section to display update information in game
Minigames should now shuffle correctly when playing a custom playlist
Challenge Zone Fixes
Fixed lighting on the Thieves monkeys
Fixed Host not playing Challenge Zone intros when playing online
Fixed lighting on the sausage in the UFO garage
Updated time estimates for Challenge Zone playtimes
Added some additional commentary to all Challenge Zones
Misc Fixes
Added some missing French VO

Thanks to everyone who's been continuing to play LEGO® Party! and to those who picked it up during the ongoing sale. v1.3 is now live, addressing various bugs and technical issues, a couple of major requests from the community, and more. Check out both the summary and in-depth patch notes below:
Easy difficulty returns to LEGO® Party! Fun for the whole family, and not the CPU's
New exciting levels (130+) added to 20 different Minigames
New Minifigures added and 250+ new parts to customise your Minifigure with
Keep the pace up, with the new ability to skip CPU turns in the Minigames
Improved stability of our online lobbies and rejoin functionality
Players no longer end up in the void when slapped in the Minigame results area
Ted & Paige got a formal warning about some of their jokes, they will be less mean spirited from now on
Earned Trophies & Achievements now unlock for all players
Various bug fixes and performance improvements
Difficulty Changes
Added New 'Easy' Mode difficulty
Expert CPU's now be able to complete Stop, Drop & Side Scroll
Expert CPU now play at the appropriate difficulty in Aim to Please
Human replacement CPUs now appear at Normal Difficulty
Customisation/Wardrobe Changes
Added additional Minifigures for purchase in the Wardrobe
Added additional notifications around non-customisable minifigures
Fixed broken wardrobe notifications
More changes and upgrades are coming!
Additional levels (130+) added for the following Minigames
Fancy Lancy
Animal Census
Rally Tally
Bricknado
Shocking Accuracy
Fall Wheel Drive
Perilous Pathways
Snailed It
Grapple & Go
Feeling Golfy
Dance Off
Donuts & Dragons
Slide Hustle
Flouncing Fishies
Carve It Up
NINJAGO® Training
Bungee Boogie
Slug It Out
Takes Two to Tanko
Brick Brigade
Minigame Changes/Fixes
Added ability to skip CPU turns in turn based Minigames
Readying up now skips your turn in Minigame practice
Fixed missing shadows on Wrecking Brawl
Light the Way minigame now show the light moving for the host as expected
Drones in Deep Space Dine no longer get stuck in the corner
Removed white boxes during transition in Arty Smarty
Fixed online animations in Drill & Chill minigame
Grey boxes now disappear in Turning Heads minigame
Player now respawn the correct way in Stop, Drop & Side Scroll
Cursor no longer appears before game start on quiz Minigames
Ten Pin Rolling scoring changed for more dynamic scores
Fixed rank positions in Simplified Chinese
Fixed controller instructions in Brick Brigade
UI/UX & Menu Fixes
Fixed stuttering when opening certain progression menus
Added Random option to Minigames game mode
Improved messaging on input of a bad name
Player no longer go slow motion when disconnecting back to the main menu
Removed excess noise when scrolling in social screen
Removed Rename button when playing local co-op
Loading screen text no longer clash with rejoin text
Scrolling the unlocks screen now speed up when button is held
Choice arrows now clear correctly in game show screens
Players can now save their game twice in a row, without losing their save
Challenge Zone Fixes
Challenge Zone junctions now use the same arrow key inputs as other minifigure movements
Playing the Pirate Challenge Zone for the first time now level the player up after completion
Slow Roller power up now give the correct number landed on
Added Golden Brick animation to the chest in Pirate Challenge Zone
Added Golden Brick decal to voting island
Added loading notification to map opening sequence
Removed disconnect icon from trap sign
Fixed white UI on chance space brick exchange
Fixed lighting on the Cat Bus in Space Challenge Zone
Removed Crystal King sword swipe effect remaining on screen in NINJAGO® challenge zone
Misc Fixes
Players can no longer slap each other out of bounds in Minigame Results
Local achievements earned now unlock across both player profiles
Fixed lag on spinning emote when playing crossplay
Added a bunch of missing studs to various models in the game
Removed some mean spirited voiceover lines
Updated Dock Icon on PC
Minifigures now load faster in the lobby
Various minor voiceover fixes
Minor localisation fixes across multiple languages

This is the first patch for LEGO® Party! We’re excited to continue to optimize and update the game for our players around the world. Expect more patches in the future and if you have any suggestions, let us know!
New Minifigures - Classic Spaceman (Blue) and free unlock of the Skeleton Suit Fan. More minifigures are coming soon!
Improvements to rejoining games in the case of player drop outs.
Difficulty settings now renamed to Normal, Hard, and Expert. New Easy mode coming soon.

Our CPU players have had a stern talking to. AI balancing applied to the following minigames; Shocking Accuracy, Saucerlord, Fancy Lancy, Very Tall Race, Perfect Pillars, Snailed It, Deep Space Dine, Quick Bricks, and Stop Drop & Side Scroll.
Ted & Paige (announcers) now can be toggled off separately to other characters. Look, they love to talk—that’s their job—but we hear you!
Additional keyboard & mouse support in menus throughout the game.
Updated save game UI - you can access your saves from the game's Main Menu.
Many other minor bug fixes and optimizations across the UI, minigames, and challenge zones.
We really appreciate everyone playing and providing us valuable feedback. We have more exciting updates and changes coming, which we will communicate over the next few months!
